motivatingPathology: This baseline is deliberately unminimized: a real visual-probe document carrying drawn and visual content with its native parts. Hand-built fixtures prove single pathologies; this one proves the round trip holds when visual markup rides along unexamined. If a future engine change breaks real files while minimized fixtures stay green, this is one of the fixtures that catches it.
knownLimitations: As a baseline it characterizes no single pathology, so a failure here diagnoses poorly without the minimized fixtures beside it. Visual content is asserted only as preserved; pixels are never compared. Mutation targets stay unformatted paragraphs by rule; replace now carries the first run's properties onto rewritten text, so the rule is conservative rather than required. One probe file generalizes nothing.
scopeExclusions: This fixture isolates no pathology: merges, revisions, drawings, numbering, and notes appear only if the source file happens to contain them. Minimized coverage lives in the hand-built fixtures, not here. Visual equivalence belongs to a rendering study, not to this structural gate.
ecma376Difficulty: Real files bundle whatever parts their authoring tool wrote, referenced through relationships with content-type declarations that must survive. A writer that rewrites only the parts it models and drops the rest will validate the body while silently losing companions. The difficulty is negative: success means touching nothing except the two mutated sentences.
licenseProvenance: Copied byte-identical from the in-repo test gallery; same repository license as the gallery source; no new provenance claims.

disposition.reason: The gallery file is Word-legal throughout, so the engine preserves every part: only the two mutated sentences change, all other parts are preserved, and the package validates clean.
